_comment: Score cutoffs for the PEDDEP graded HiChIP QC report. 'higher': value >= cutoffs[i] earns -1, 0, +1, +2 (below the first cutoff = -2); 'lower': value <= cutoffs[i] earns -1, 0, +1, +2 (above the first cutoff = -2). 'status': FastQC-style pass = +2, warn = 0, fail = -2. FRiP, Total_Peaks and loop counts are not graded for INPUT libraries. Metrics not listed are reported but not graded. Contact cutoffs follow common HiChIP guidance (Dovetail/Arima); review them against your own libraries.
